messages:
nina: shared a compact "mini-rail" concept for onboarding that sits at bottom-right and expands on hover/click. figma: https://figma.com/file/mini-rail-2026 — quick glance pls :eyes:
frank: looks neat. is the rail persistent across sessions or just until sample created?
nina: plan is persistent until the sample project is created or user dismisses permanently. needs server-side persist flag for cross-device behavior.
anya: a11y first pass: collapsed state must expose a visible focus target; current collapsed icon has no keyboard focus ring. also contrast on the tiny badge number is below AA.
a11y-bot: automated scan: collapsed icon fails keyboard-focus (tabindex missing). badge text contrast ratio 2.8:1 (fail). expand state: modal-like panel lacks aria-modal attribute.
dom: implementation note: easy to client-flag show/hide, but server flag required for dismissal. expansion panel can reuse existing popover; will need to add aria-modal and focus return behavior.
max: copy idea: micro-CTA should be verb-first and explicit: "Create sample" (not "Try this"). add short descriptor: "Create a sample project with API key" rather than vague phrasing.
anya: also suggest adding a small inline tooltip for the API key step warning about ephemeral keys and where to rotate them. ensure the tooltip is keyboard accessible.
nina: telemetry names — please standardize so metrics map cleanly. proposed events:

```
onboard.mini_rail_impression
onboard.mini_rail_expand
onboard.sample_create
onboard.sample_dismiss
```

frank: agree. also record experiment cohort id on impressions.
dom: rollout plan: quick client feature-flag + a11y fixes -> 1 sprint. server-side dismiss + telemetry hooks -> +1 sprint. modal-focus improvements -> +1 more sprint if we need to convert to true modal behavior.
anya: accessibility checklist I'll add to the ticket: keyboard nav, screen reader announce on expand, focus return on dismiss, contrast fixes, tooltip keyboard access, alt text for thumbnails.
max: UX nit: when sample creation is in progress show a concise inline status and don't navigate away. after creation show a small toast with the command to run locally and a copy button: `redwood samples start <sample-name>` so users hit API fast.
nina: good. next steps: 1) dom to prototype client flag + focusable collapsed icon; 2) anya to update comps with contrast and focus states; 3) max to lock down CTAs and command microcopy; 4) frank to add telemetry names and experiment fields. I'll file ticket and schedule 3 quick smoke sessions.
frank: can we recruit two recent signups for the smoke test? Helps measure first-call latency.
dom: will open PR draft for client flag and link it in the ticket.
anya: attaching accessibility checklist to the ticket once comps are updated.
nina: filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-867 — pls add comments. smoke tests scheduled for tomorrow 10:00am PT. thanks all :sparkles:
